incidents.correction: Controller v2 supports versioned schema families plus control_epoch/control_bundle and fail-closed durability status.
incidents.root_cause: Controller schema contract did not evolve with HEAD/RUN_QUEUE versioning.
incidents.symptom: Canonical controller v1 rejected/was incompatible with active V173 schemas and protocol_ref v1.1.

incidents.correction: V1.2 requires atomic CAS; when surface cannot do atomic multi-file writes, staged migration keeps old HEAD authority until final activation and epoch mismatch blocks science.
incidents.root_cause: Available connector write surface was used directly instead of canonical CAS transaction.
incidents.scientific_impact: NONE_OBSERVED; temporary HEAD/STATE/QUEUE drift was possible.
incidents.symptom: Several control updates used sequential Contents API writes although protocol specifies atomic Git CAS.

incidents.correction: Derived runner must be persisted/readback verified and PASS_EXACT equivalent before production. V175-dependent outputs quarantined.
incidents.root_cause: No mandatory pre-production derived-runner durability gate.
incidents.symptom: Derived accelerators V174/V175 were used locally before universal durability enforcement; V175 source is not found durable in main.

incidents.correction: Receipt-authoritative half-open ranges; tail truncate to committed raw_done; contiguous first-occurrence UID; no AUTOINCREMENT; checkpoint gate.
incidents.root_cause: Checkpoint authority and deterministic UID allocation were not globally enforced.
incidents.scientific_impact: NONE_ACCEPTED; failures occurred before authoritative merge or were repaired locally.
incidents.symptom: SQLite tails after process cut, AUTOINCREMENT gaps, and intra-batch duplicate-new-UID collision.

incidents.correction: Exact gzip+base64 carrier is executable authority; Git blob readback must match precomputed blob.
incidents.root_cause: Text transfer path not guaranteed byte-identical.
incidents.symptom: Readable GitHub mirrors V172/V174 and new control mirrors could differ bytewise from tested local source.

incidents.correction: Rematerialization manifests must list every required component; missing component means failure, not completion.
incidents.root_cause: Rematerialization success did not require a complete component manifest.
incidents.scientific_impact: NONE_ACCEPTED; unions regenerated and checked before outcomes.
incidents.symptom: A rematerialized M1 MID workdir lacked union_buy/union_sell component files despite DB/mapping success.

incidents.correction: Only deterministic chunk/cache/vectorization/accelerator routes allowed, and accelerator must be durable plus PASS_EXACT before authoritative use.
incidents.root_cause: Repeated feature construction, independent slow path, dense mask greedy loops, and per-call initialization.
incidents.scientific_impact: NONE; slowness is not a scientific gate.
incidents.symptom: Original prepare/scorer and repeated cold starts exceeded bounded runtime.

incidents.correction: Runtime loss is recovery event; deterministic rematerialization only from frozen input+runner and expected outputs.
incidents.symptom: Ephemeral runtime occasionally lost DEV/cache/workdirs, described as recovery/data problems.

incidents.correction: Legacy defect quarantined; use verified blob/carrier identity and never silently correct.
